key_insights: Bitcoin could reach $200T market cap if it becomes universal hard money rather than just digital gold
Bitcoin has a strong chance of reaching parity with gold's market cap within the next five years
Ethereum plays a complementary role to Bitcoin rather than being mutually exclusive
Stock-to-flow model is fundamentally flawed despite popularity; the co-integration argument was debunked
Roll-ups are the most sound scaling solution for Ethereum rather than sharding
Ethereum faces competition from alternative chains due to high fees creating trading opportunities
summary: Eric Wall is strongly bullish on Bitcoin long-term with a target of $200T market cap if it becomes universal money. He believes Bitcoin could reach parity with gold's market cap within five years. For Ethereum, he sees it as complementary to Bitcoin with the strongest likelihood of success among smart contract platforms. He's critical of the stock-to-flow model and identifies trading opportunities in Ethereum competitors due to scaling issues. He prefers Bitcoin and Ethereum over DeFi tokens due to regulatory concerns.
